# Glossary

**Root** — a single folder the server is pointed at. One kbview instance can serve
several roots at once.

**Vault mode** — the behaviour kbview switches into when a root contains a
`.obsidian/` directory: wikilinks, embeds and callouts become meaningful.

**Unresolved link** — a wikilink whose target basename matches no file in the root.

**Transclusion** — an embed of one note's body inside another, written `![[Note]]`.
